name: Ansalent Soosaipillai
headline: Head of Software Delivery (APAC) at Ingenico
about:
Experienced Technical/Product/Project/program/Delivery Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Strong product management professional skilled in Embedded Software, Electronic Payments, Requirements Analysis, and Agile Methodologies.

• 25+ years experience in EFTPOS industry.
• 15+ years experience in program/project management.
• 14 years experience as development manager.
• 5+ years experience in product/solution management
• In-depth knowledge of EFTPOS security requirements.
• Ability to direct complex projects from concept to fully operational status.
• Project management of multiple projects simultaneously.
• Goal-oriented individual with strong leadership capabilities.
• Organised, highly motivated, and detail-directed problem solver.
• Proven ability to work in a team or individual orientated environment.
